labels.label: btzthm:BTZ_Cauchy-completness
labels.notes: Unmarked (docstring l.9 names the label without **), and the REPORT row is partial. That is right: this is one step of the proof (the input to lem:surface_complete at BTZ_1.tex:1601), not the theorem. I read the statements against the paper and against the strict GX.E0BluntSpear.lem_blunt_spear (GX/BTZ/BluntSpear.lean:1049). (1) trace_spacelikeDevelopment carries the target's setting as printed. Two hypotheses are unused, InjOn psi W and Sig Cauchy; both are disclosed as weakened, and both are carried only where lem_blunt_spear needs them. One hypothesis is added, hpos : v + |z|/2 < tauS z. It is necessary: hgraph is an iff on bspear v R = {v <= fcoord}, so without hpos the point (tauS z, z) need not lie in the spear, and tauS need not be the trace there. It is also justified: lem_blunt_spear returns v + R'/2 < tauS z, which implies hpos for |z| <= R', and lem_blunt_spear_trace (l.654) derives it that way. It is disclosed in the checklist and in REPORT.hypotheses. The conclusion is a conjunction: periodicity, an embedding of the closed strip, local spacelike-Lipschitz charts at every r < R, and SpacelikeDevelopment (openGraphDev ...). Nothing in it is vacuous. (2) trace_spacelikeDevelopment_openStrip states SpacelikeDevelopment (graphDevOn (traceFun tauS) (openStrip R)). That is exactly hF of the scaffold lem_surface_complete_two_lipOn (C1SpacelikeDevLip.lean:452) with Omega = openStrip R. (3) trace_tendsto_atTop applies that lemma for 0 < R'' < R, with stripSet R'' a subset of openStrip R. Completeness of the pulled length over (0,R''] stays a hypothesis; this is disclosed, and it is T-btz-trace-complete. Shrinking R'' < R once more is within l.1601's « one can reduce the size of S ». (4) lem_blunt_spear_trace chains lem_blunt_spear correctly: its R' and tauS are re-exported with lem_blunt_spear's own v + R'/2 bound, and the result is non-vacuous because its hypotheses are lem_blunt_spear's. (5) flatE0_regChart is faithful to its docstring, as the FlatE0 N analogue of eventually_regChart: on an open U inside W and the slit sector of y, the chart of N at psi x composed with psi is g • sectorChartY y. (6) not_spacelikeDevelopment_graphDev is true for every g when R > 0, and the kernel checks it. It duplicates one direction of the other target's E0Surgery.spacelikeDevelopment_graphDev_iff (C1SpacelikeDev.lean:184). As a not_ declaration it refutes the roadmap target's planned conclusion and the hypothesis hF of the strict lem_surface_complete_two_lip; it refutes no printed paper statement, so it should stay out of the curated decls for this label. The REPORT lists it in labels[0].decls, and the loop should drop it at curation. The finding that GX.E0Surgery.lem_surface_complete_two_lip (GX/BTZ/SurfaceCompleteLip.lean:365) is vacuous is correct: its hF is exactly SpacelikeDevelopment (graphDev g R) with 0 < R.
